title: E2MoCase: A Dataset for Emotional, Event and Moral Observations in News Articles on High-impact Legal Cases
reasoning: The paper focuses on the 'Moral Trait' as a core dimension of its new dataset, using Moral Foundation Theory to classify news articles into categories such as Care/Harm, Fairness/Cheating, Loyalty/Betrayal, Authority/Subversion, and Sanctity/Degradation. It also specifically addresses 'religious bias' as a factor in case selection.
